Principal General Practitioner with broad experience across women's health, child health, chronic disease, mental health, and travel medicine.

field.name: bio
field.p: Dr. Rimi is an experienced General Practitioner with over nine years of practice in Australia. She has worked in a variety of general practices and regional hospitals, including rural areas in South Australia and Victoria. As a Fellow of the Royal Australian College of General Practitioners (FRACGP), she brings a wealth of expertise and a passion for patient care.

Her special interests include Women's Health, Child Health, Chronic Diseases, Mental Health, and Travel Medicine. Dr. Rimi is skilled in managing menstrual disorders, perimenopause, menopause, post-menopause care, and family planning. She also has significant experience working with adolescent patients facing mental health issues.

In addition to her work in general practice, Dr. Rimi has experience in emergency medicine, sports medicine, and minor surgical procedures. She is particularly passionate about caring for the elderly, ensuring they receive the attention and support they deserve.

Outside of work, Dr. Rimi enjoys spending time with her family, including her two young children and elderly parents, whom she personally cares for. She loves cooking, exploring different cuisines and reading books.

Nirav Sanjanwala from Go Run Go Physio is a qualified physiotherapist with over two decades of private practice experience, providing evidence-based care for musculoskeletal, sports, spinal, neurological, and orthopaedic rehabilitation.

field.name: bio
field.p: Nirav Sanjanwala from Go Run Go Physio is a qualified physiotherapist with over two decades of experience as a private practitioner.
He holds a physiotherapy degree and a postgraduate diploma in musculoskeletal physiotherapy from the University of Melbourne.

His clinical work includes sports injuries, spinal conditions, neurological disorders, orthopaedic rehabilitation, and structured support for chronic and complex conditions. He has also worked in post-acute care and community health physiotherapy.
Nirav uses an evidence-based, collaborative approach focused on improving function, restoring independence, and helping patients achieve measurable recovery outcomes.

Stephen Devenish from LiveWell Podiatry is a podiatrist focused on foot and lower-limb care, helping patients improve comfort, mobility, and function across everyday activity, sport, and longer-term recovery.

field.name: bio
field.p: Stephen Devenish from LiveWell Podiatry is a podiatrist who enjoys helping people get back on their feet and return to the activities that matter to them, whether that is sport, time with grandkids, or everyday mobility.
He takes a practical approach centred on movement, comfort, and long-term function, with a focus on identifying the cause of the issue rather than offering only a short-term fix.

His podiatry care covers a wide range of foot and lower-limb concerns including nails, callouses and corns, warts, ingrown nails, diabetes foot health assessments, heel pain, sports injuries, children's feet, and gait or running assessments.
Stephen also bulk bills eligible EPC/Medicare, DVA, and TAC referrals, and offers home visits in the Carrum Downs, Seaford, and Frankston area.
